nodes.title: CLIP Text Encode (Prompt) positive
widgets_values:
Use the provided image as the exact visual reference and preserve the same woman, appearance, outfit, microphone, composition, lighting, and overall cinematic style.
A young female singer performs directly to camera with highly accurate lip-sync, her lips and mouth movements precisely matching every syllable and phoneme of the provided lyrics. Her facial expressions naturally follow the emotion and meaning of each lyric: subtle smiles, emotional eyes, gentle eyebrow movements, slight changes in expression, and natural breathing.
She maintains soft eye contact with the camera, occasionally shifting her gaze naturally as if emotionally immersed in the song. Her free hand makes elegant, subtle gestures that visually emphasize the lyrics, while the hand holding the vintage microphone remains natural and stable. Small head movements, gentle body sways, and expressive posture add realism without changing her position or identity.
The colorful bokeh lights in the background slowly drift and shimmer with soft, dreamy movement, creating depth while remaining heavily out of focus. Cinematic shallow depth of field, realistic skin, natural facial motion, subtle hair movement, soft volumetric lighting, beautiful highlights, smooth camera movement, emotional live-performance atmosphere.
Keep the performance elegant, intimate, and realistic. No exaggerated facial expressions, no excessive body movement, no camera shake, no changes to clothing or background structure. Maintain consistent identity and composition throughout.

inputs.text: A medium close-up shot features a Caucasian man with a closely shaven head and face, wearing a black baseball cap with "PNTR" in white letters on the front, and a dark grey t-shirt with "JUST DO IT" visible across his chest. A small black microphone is clipped to his shirt collar. He is positioned slightly to the left of the frame, looking intently downwards and to his right, his eyes focused off-camera. His facial expression is one of deep concentration, with his brow slightly furrowed. As he looks down, a quick sniff sound is heard, and then he speaks with a deep male voice and a slightly frustrated tone, saying, "I think it's so bad." The camera remains static throughout, maintaining a shallow depth of field, which keeps the man in sharp focus while the background is softly blurred, revealing a light-colored wall with white wooden shelving or trim, and a partially open white wooden door on the right. After a brief pause, another short, audible sniff is heard. The man then continues to speak, his voice maintaining the same quality, as he states, "So bad. So bad." He elaborates further, emphasizing his point with a final statement, "This got to be, it's got to be the worst tool I've ever seen."
